summary: Argentina wins the World Cup in a dramatic penalty shootout, with Emiliano Martínez's key saves and Gonzalo Montiel's decisive kick securing victory; Lionel Messi's emotional celebration marks a career-defining moment as Argentina ends a 36-year title drought.

video_highlights.highlight: The Argentina team celebrates on the field, indicating they have won the penalty shootout, with players displaying gestures of joy and triumph.
Kingsley Coman takes his penalty, but the Argentine goalkeeper saves it, prompting loud whistles and the commentator exclaiming, "Coman. Great stop."
Argentina nears victory as a commentator declares, "And Argentina are on the cusp," with players celebrating this critical turning point.
The audio declares, "Argentina. Champions of the world," confirming their victory in the penalty shootout, with players and fans celebrating in the stadium.
Lionel Messi falls to his knees in the center circle, overwhelmed by emotion, as Argentina secures victory, with the audio marking it as his career-defining moment.
Commentary describes Messi's monumental achievement as "shaking hands with paradise," while players in blue and white uniforms celebrate on the field.
